feature.title: Install Grafana dashboards from Keystone Charts on iOS and macOS
feature.description: Plan dashboard install for the synthetic Keystone native-apple/charts module. An operator previews a Grafana dashboard definition and explicitly installs it into the local Charts catalog from an iPhone or Mac.
acceptanceCriteria: iOS and macOS preview the same dashboard UID, title and panel list before install.
Cancel preserves the current catalog. Confirm persists exactly one dashboard for that UID.
Invalid input and storage failures display recoverable errors without a partial install.
The plan specifies shared Charts code and the platform-specific UI and verification needed on iOS and macOS.

bug.title: Preserve Grafana datasource placeholders during Charts dashboard install
bug.description: A dashboard with an unresolved datasource placeholder previews correctly. After local install, Keystone Charts drops the placeholder and renders an empty panel. Plan the fix for iOS and macOS using a synthetic manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: A regression fixture reproduces the placeholder loss at the preview-to-install transition.
Both apps preserve the placeholder until the local installation resolves it, or surface a useful validation error.
Install persists no partial dashboard on validation failure.
